summary: [standards] Registry and hint texts that no longer say what the call sites do: APPROVAL_INVALID's meaning and fix still read '`brief approve` got an empty or multi-line --by or --note' / 'Pass ... --approver and --note to `canon brief approve`' (--by went in 0.28; `policy approve` with a blank --approver now emits it and so does an evidence approver) so `canon schema --error APPROVAL_INVALID` misdirects a policy caller; INVENTORY_INDEX_UNAVAILABLE is retryable but the call's hint is the generic 'fix the problems the message names, then run again' (no 'wait'); the subject adopt/unadopt NOT_FOUND refusals keep the generic 'fix what the message names' hint. Reword them.
